name: book_appointment
description: Create a booking in ServiceTitan. Call this AFTER customer confirms the service fee and chooses an appointment time. You MUST include the issue description with full details about the customer's problem.

customer_name.description: Customer's full name (First Last). Example: 'John Smith'

address.description: Full service address including street, city, state, and zip. Example: '123 Main Street, Painesville, OH 44077'

issue.description: REQUIRED: Full description of customer's problem. Include: what's wrong, equipment type (AC, furnace, boiler, etc.), system age if known, how long problem has been occurring, any vulnerable occupants (baby, elderly). Example: 'AC not working at all, no air from vents, 10 year old system, started yesterday, has baby in home'

appointment_time.description: Requested appointment window. Use exactly: 'morning 8-12' for morning, 'afternoon 12-4' for afternoon, or 'asap' for emergency same-day service

is_emergency.description: Set to TRUE for No A/C (no cooling at all) or No Heat (no heating at all) situations, especially with vulnerable occupants. Set to FALSE for minor issues, maintenance, tune-ups, quotes.
